items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: The other guy was named David Something.

ctx.x: Francisco, moved down there. We moved down and started recording with Dick Bock. In fact, we had to hold him back; he was going to make them too often.

So the group moved down to San Francisco because we had this job there. We went over great and after...The guy that... There were two partners that owned the Showcase and they were both attorneys Auerbach and the other guy was named David Something. And Arthur Auerbach ended up buying a place up there on the Strip (Broadway) in San Francisco. I t was called the Jazz Workshop. So he invested in that place, but all he wanted that for was just to have a door open on Broadway. He was using local people, like the…

So after the Mastersounds had worked the Showcase, the Showcase was sort of like...the life of the Showcase was sort of ending because I guess it wasn't too much of a success without selling booze to bring in the names.
